verdict.rationale: BILL documents registrable webhook subscriptions for chosen events, delivered to a `notificationUrl` and signed with HMAC-SHA256 so receivers can verify them. The docs explicitly cover Spend & Expense events and S&E-specific webhook API errors, and set a limit of 10 subscriptions per organization. missing for 10: an itemized catalog of S&E-specific event types or payloads (the only payload doc cited is for AP vendor autopay), independent or hands-on corroboration.
